commands.checks: Authenticated source execution; exact forward and adjoint phases/ranks, every added occurrence, inherited native channel, full358-input forward composition, semantic controls and complete regenerated payload.

Eight behavior groups: missing evidence, source drift, malformed receipt, exclusive output, Git-free read-only and gzip-equivalent replay, phase-predicate deletion; executable timestamp and unchecked-hash caches ignored across the full source graph, valid regeneration accepts and wrong-phase native recipe rejects.
